why_it_moved.text: Successful Search Rate rose +0.81% while Long Click Rate moved only +0.12%, so more searches ended in a click but the scorecard does not show those clicks lasting.
why_it_moved.label: measured

why_it_moved.text: The ranker may surface results that get clicked but are abandoned quickly; no segment cuts were read, so the mechanism is not known.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: More data showing Long Click Rate up by at least +0.5% would make the second primary clear its bar.
A pre-period comparison that shows the two arms were alike before exposure would close the one check that could not run.
